name: Águas do Caramulo
note: Mineral-water company founded in 1984, based in Varzielas (LinkedIn company page). Who owns it isn't sourced, so it isn't rated yet. Was on the left sleeve of Académico de Viseu's shirts in 2022-23 and 2023-24 (club news, 19 Oct 2023); no source other than Wikipedia puts it on the 2026-27 home kit.
